cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式马来语文本写 Houston，首字母大写。首次向不熟悉美国地理的读者介绍时，可写 Houston, Texas, Amerika Syarikat。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈旅行、会议或居住地点时可直接使用。若出现在完整人名中，应按人名理解，并尊重当事人的姓名读音。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式马来语文本写 Houston，首字母大写。首次向不熟悉美国地理的读者介绍时，可写 Houston, Texas, Amerika Syarikat。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈旅行、会议或居住地点时可直接使用。若出现在完整人名中，应按人名理解，并尊重当事人的姓名读音。

etymology.historical_story: Houston was founded in 1836 by the Allen brothers and named in honour of General Sam Houston. The place name therefore preserves a person's surname. This gives learners a concrete connection between a map label and a historical figure: the city carries the name of the man it commemorates. [Source: City of Houston](https://www.houstontx.gov/abouthouston/cityhallhistory.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“休斯顿”，开头像英语 hue；把 Houston 与中文地名“休斯敦”一起记，不按 hou 拼读成“豪”。

senses.zh_definition: 使某物、痕迹、感觉或问题消失；去除，消除。

senses.nuances: hilangkan 是带 -kan 的及物词形，常见于指令，如 Hilangkan kesan itu，也可用于第一、第二人称被动结构，如 Kesan itu perlu saya hilangkan。普通正式主动陈述通常用 menghilangkan，如 Sabun ini menghilangkan kotoran；口语中也常省略 meN-。hilang 表示自行消失或不见，hilangkan 则表示使其消失。核心释义依据：[DBP PRPM：menghilangkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menghilangkan)。

etymology.historical_story: hilangkan 由 hilang 加上使役后缀 -kan 构成，把“不见了”的状态转为“使它不见”的动作。这个构词关系贯穿具体与抽象表达：既可去除污渍和气味，也可消除疑虑或恐惧；相应的完整主动词形是 menghilangkan。

etymology.historical_story: Hannah derives from Hebrew Ḥannah, associated with favour or grace. In the biblical tradition, Hannah is Samuel's mother. The name travelled across languages alongside related forms such as Anna and Anne. These historical connections explain similarities between names, but a Malaysian bearer named Hannah still has an individual name whose spelling and pronunciation should be respected. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/hannah).

etymology.historical_story: Holmes has several surname origins, including names associated with landscape features or places called Holm. Its literary fame comes from Arthur Conan Doyle's detective, introduced in A Study in Scarlet in 1887. That character made an existing family name internationally recognizable; the surname itself was not invented for the detective. Sources: [Findmypast](https://www.findmypast.co.uk/surname/holmes), [Penguin](https://www.penguin.co.uk/discover/articles/where-to-start-with-sherlock-holmes).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Holmes 常读近似“侯姆兹”，l 不发音；联想福尔摩斯举起放大镜，但记住其他姓 Holmes 的人未必译作福尔摩斯。

senses.nuances: 与 dengan 连用时常表示“对……满意”，不一定指情绪兴奋；标准语可改用 berpuas hati dengan。DBP 的翻译建议也按语境区分 gembira 与 berpuas hati，见[DBP 翻译咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=happy)。

etymology.historical_story: English happy has a historical connection with hap, meaning luck or fortune. Its story links favourable circumstances with the feeling of pleasure they can produce. When happy appears inside a Malay conversation, that English history remains relevant; the surrounding Malay grammar does not turn it into a native Malay affixed formation. [English origin](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=happy)

senses.ms_definition: Kehidupan atau nyawa; tempoh seseorang atau sesuatu itu hidup.
senses.nuances: 比日常的 hidup 更具书面色彩，常见于 sepanjang hayat 和 jangka hayat。用于设备时，jangka hayat 引申为使用寿命；不能把所有表示“日常生活”的 kehidupan 都直接替换成 hayat。释义参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=300728&keyword=hayat)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: hayat 常用于庄重或关怀性的表达，如 sepanjang hayat。谈及个人剩余寿命时应顾及对方感受，避免无根据地判断。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 描述终身学习用 pembelajaran sepanjang hayat；描述人或产品的寿命用 jangka hayat。讨论电池一次充电能用多久，通常说 bateri tahan berapa lama，并说明是一次充电。

etymology.historical_story: hayat 借自阿拉伯语表示“生命”的 ḥayāh（حياة），进入马来语后保留了“活着、生命”的核心意义。它也进入 sepanjang hayat 等时间表达，并在 menghayati 中呈现“内心亲自体验、深切领会”的意义联系。借词来源与派生义参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=300728&keyword=hayat)，阿拉伯语原词参见 [Quranic Arabic Corpus](https://corpus.quran.com/qurandictionary.jsp?q=Hyy)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hayat 想成从出生延伸到生命终点的一条线：sepanjang hayat 是沿着整条线，jangka hayat 是这条线有多长。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语词形，不能标为官方马来语词条。英语中为单音节，双写 ll 不构成两个音节；输入中的 various translations 不是音节信息。以下词族属于英语。

senses.zh_definition: 英语名词：小山；丘陵。马来语通常对应 bukit。
senses.en_definition: A natural elevation of land, generally lower than a mountain; the English counterpart of Malay bukit.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang berpadanan dengan bukit, iaitu kawasan tanah tinggi yang umumnya lebih rendah daripada gunung.
senses.nuances: 此处保留输入键名，提供外语辨识及马来语对应信息；不把 hill 认证为马来语借词，也不声称这是其全部英语义项。下列 ms 搭配使用对应词 bukit。英语词义参见 [Merriam-Webster：hill](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hill)；马来语对应词参见 [DBP：bukit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=bukit)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论英语或与熟悉双语表达的朋友交谈时可以引用 hill；面向一般马来语读者时，使用 bukit 更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 普通地貌名称可译为 bukit；专有地名、机构名或品牌中的 Hill，应核对其既定名称后处理，避免机械翻译。

etymology.historical_story: English hill descends through Middle English from Old English hyll. Its presence in a Malay corpus may reflect quotation, an English place name, or language mixing; the packet alone cannot establish which. For a trilingual learner, the useful connection is geographical rather than morphological: English hill corresponds to Malay bukit and Chinese 小山 or 山丘. [Merriam-Webster：hill](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hill)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 hill 的两个 l 立在小山顶上；跨语对应记作 hill → bukit → 山丘。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于文学、影视和粉丝交流。正式介绍时首次写出 Rubeus Hagrid，并交代其为虚构角色，方便不熟悉作品的读者理解。

etymology.historical_story: Rowling explained in a 1999 interview that Hagrid came from a dialect expression associated with having had a bad night, linking it humorously to the character’s drinking. This is an author-reported naming story, rather than a Malay derivation. Readers should remember Hagrid as a character’s name, not translate it literally whenever it appears. [Archived interview summary](https://www.accio-quote.org/themes/hagrid.htm)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语读音 /ˈhæɡrɪd/ 与“海格”的人物形象绑定：体格巨大、心地善良；不必硬拆词根。

morphology.pattern_note: 按韩语 형 分析，为一个音节，末尾 /ŋ/ 类似马来语 ng。hyung 是流行罗马字写法，韩国现行修订罗马字写作 hyeong；不存在马来语词缀拆分。

senses.zh_definition: 韩语称谓：男性称呼或指称比自己年长的兄弟，也可用于年长的堂兄或表兄。
senses.en_definition: A Korean term used by a male for an older brother or older male cousin.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Korea, panggilan atau sebutan oleh lelaki bagi saudara lelaki atau sepupu lelaki yang lebih tua daripadanya.
senses.nuances: 本条按韩语 형（兄）解释；IPA 为韩语源语读音。此义涉及男性使用者与年长男性亲属的关系。输入没有 DBP 定义，因此不能标为已核实的官方马来语词条；马来文释义为编写释义。义项依据 [韩国国立国语院《韩国语基础词典》](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=20286)。以下搭配为马来文解释性表达，不是马来语频率统计结果。

etymology.historical_story: Korean 형 is a Sino-Korean word associated with the character 兄, meaning older brother. Its dictionary senses cover both older male relatives and affectionate reference to older men by male speakers. Hyung represents that Korean expression in Roman letters; its appearance in Malay discussion does not establish official Malay lexical status. [Source: National Institute of Korean Language](https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=20286).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“兄→哥”：男性对年长男性说 hyung；一个音节，末尾 ng 收住，不再加一个 g 音。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -kan 接在 hasil 后，词根不变；对应主动陈述式 menghasilkan。输入 Jawi 保留的是 hasil 的拼写，未包含 -kan。

senses.zh_definition: 制作或创作出某物；使某种成果产生，常用于指令中的“做出、创作出”。

senses.ms_definition: Mendatangkan atau mengeluarkan hasil; mencipta sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常见于祈使句，如 Hasilkan sebuah poster。也用于第一、第二人称被动结构，如 poster yang saya hasilkan；标准主动陈述通常用 menghasilkan，不宜写成 Syarikat itu hasilkan produk baharu。词义依据 [PRPM：hasil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=hasil) 中的 menghasilkan。

etymology.historical_story: 词根 hasil 源于阿拉伯语中表示获得或所得的词族，进入马来语后用于表示收成、收入与成果。加上 -kan 后，“所得的成果”成为“把成果做出来”的动作，现代用法可指制作海报或创作作品。阿拉伯语来源参见 [Wikikamus：hasil](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/hasil)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hasil 是桌上的成品；加上 -kan，就像有人指着空桌子说：“把成果做出来！”——hasilkan。

etymology.historical_story: Harrison developed as an English patronymic surname meaning son of Harry. Harry was a familiar form of Henry, so the name originally identified someone through a father’s personal name. It later also became a given name. In Malay usage, Harrison remains a complete proper name rather than a productive Malay derivative. [Source: Behind the Name](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/harrison)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 Harry’s son 联想 Harrison，记住其历史含义“Harry 的儿子”；现代使用时把它当完整姓名，不据此推断父亲的实际名字。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root 沿用输入包，表示未作马来语词缀分析；英语 hatter 实际包含施事后缀 -er。双写 t 不表示两个独立的 /t/ 音。

senses.zh_definition: 英语名词：制作、销售或清洗修理帽子的人。
senses.en_definition: A person whose occupation involves making, selling, cleaning, or repairing hats.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Inggeris bagi orang yang membuat, menjual, membersihkan atau membaiki topi.
senses.nuances: 此处解释英语普通名词，不宣称它是正式马来语词条。马来语通常按实际工作使用 pembuat topi、penjual topi 等表达。若原文写作 Hatter，也可能是姓名或角色称号，须另行消歧。音标为英式英语参考读音。以下为解释英语词时使用的马来语表达，并非经语料验证的高频搭配。释义参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hatter)。

collocations.zh: 制帽或经营帽子这一职业

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 普通职业名词写作 hatter；姓名或角色称号可能写作 Hatter。不能仅凭无上下文的词形把某个人认定为制帽者。

etymology.historical_story: Hatter belongs to the English pattern of naming workers with an occupational ending. Its connection with hat makes the basic meaning transparent, but the occupation can include selling and maintaining hats as well as making them. In a Malay explanation, naming the person's actual work often communicates more clearly than retaining the English label. [Definition](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hatter)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语 hat 是帽子，-er 表示从事者：hat → hatter，想到帽子师傅。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词进入语码混用，不拆成马来语词缀。此处 IPA 为常见英式读音；马来语口语中的元音可接近 /o/，没有据此确定唯一的马来语标准读音。

senses.zh_definition: 热的；温度高的，用于夹杂英语的日常表达。
senses.en_definition: Having a high temperature; used in English–Malay code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Bersuhu tinggi atau terasa panas, dalam pertuturan yang mencampurkan bahasa Inggeris dengan bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 正式马来语一般用 panas。PRPM 收录英语 hot 的英马词典条目，并不等于确认它是正式马来语形容词。这里及下列义项的马来语释义均为编辑释义。[DBP：英语 hot](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=hot)。

senses.zh_definition: 热门的；正受关注或引发热议的。
senses.en_definition: Currently popular or attracting considerable public attention.
senses.ms_definition: Sedang popular atau mendapat perhatian dan perbincangan ramai.
senses.nuances: 常见于娱乐、宣传和社交媒体语境。正式表达按语义选 hangat、popular 或 mendapat perhatian ramai；“热门”本身不表示消息已经核实。[DBP：hangat 的新闻及事件义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=hangat)。

senses.ms_definition: Menarik dari segi penampilan fizikal sehingga menimbulkan tarikan seksual.
senses.nuances: 属于非正式、带性吸引意味的英语用法，不能一律译成普通的“漂亮”。用于评价真人时，可能使对方感到被物化。[Cambridge：hot](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hot)。

etymology.historical_story: Hot enters mixed Malay conversation as an English word. Its literal temperature meaning extends metaphorically to news that attracts attention and people considered sexually attractive. These meanings belong to English usage carried into conversation. Their presence in Malaysian speech does not by itself establish hot as an officially standardized Malay headword.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hot 的核心画面是“热”：东西热、话题热、人很性感，都从同一个英语词记起；正式马来语再按语境换词。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为阿拉伯语借词整体记忆；词尾 -in 源于原语言的复数形式，不是现代马来语可自由使用的后缀。

etymology.historical_story: hadirin 借自阿拉伯语，原形式带有“在场者们”的复数意义。进入马来语后，它作为完整词汇表示活动中的全体到场人士，并保留了庄重的集体称呼功能。[DBP 词源标注](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=hadirin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象司仪面对满座礼堂说出 hadirin：镜头从一个 hadir（到场）的人拉远，变成全体在场来宾。

headword.verification_note: 可核实为《火影忍者》中的日语来源称号 Hokage，但未能核实为正式马来语词条，不能标记为 official。IPA 为日语读音的宽式语音转写，不代表已确立的马来语标准发音。排名未经独立验证。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语讨论中按外来称号整词处理，不分析为马来语词缀结构。日语读音包含 ho、ka、ge 三个音拍；输入未提供音节划分。

senses.zh_definition: 火影：日本漫画及动画《火影忍者》中，木叶隐村领导者所持有的称号。
senses.en_definition: The title held by the leader of the Hidden Leaf Village in Naruto.
senses.ms_definition: Gelaran bagi pemimpin Kampung Konoha dalam karya manga dan anime Naruto.
senses.nuances: 属于虚构世界的特定称号，通常写作 Hokage；不泛指所有忍者村的领导者，也不是马来西亚现实行政职称。马来语释义为编写释义，非 DBP 官方引文。[《火影忍者》官方网站](https://naruto-official.com/en/news/01_1321)。

etymology.historical_story: Hokage belongs to the Japanese fictional setting of Naruto, where it names the leadership office of the Hidden Leaf Village. The official series website uses the title when describing the village's leaders and their responsibilities. Its appearance in Malay fan conversation is a cultural reference, rather than evidence of a traditional Malay administrative term. [NARUTO official site](https://naruto-official.com/en/news/01_1321).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 ho-ka-ge 三拍读，直接联想“火影—木叶村领导者”；把称号和所属村庄一起记住。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是计量符号的组合，不是马来语词缀派生；h 表示百倍，m 表示米。符号本身没有固定音节或词汇音标，通常按全称 hektometer 读出。

senses.zh_definition: 长度单位“百米”的符号；1 hm 等于 100 米。
senses.en_definition: The symbol for the hectometre, a unit of length equal to 100 metres.
senses.ms_definition: Kependekan bagi hektometer, iaitu unit ukuran panjang yang bersamaan dengan 100 meter.
senses.nuances: 本条依据词典所收的计量用法，词性按其代表的单位名归为名词。它不表示聊天中犹豫或思考的声音；实际读数时通常读出 hektometer。符号组合见国际计量规则：h 表示 100，m 表示米。[DBP：hm](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=hm)；[NIST：SI 前缀](https://www.nist.gov/pml/owm/metric-si-prefixes)；[BIPM：米](https://www.bipm.org/en/si-base-units/metre)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 主要用于数学、测量或单位换算语境。日常说明距离时，可直接说 300 meter，避免对方把独立出现的 hm 当作思考声。

etymology.historical_story: hm 的形成遵循公制用单位前缀表示十进倍数的传统：把表示百倍的 h 放在米的符号 m 前面，就得到百米单位。马来语词典将它收入为 hektometer 的缩写，因此它进入词典的路径来自计量记号，而非普通词语的词缀变化。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 h＝100、m＝米：hm 就是一组 100 米；3 hm 就是三组 100 米。

morphology.pattern_note: 按完整借词记忆，不把词尾 in 当作马来语后缀；首音节 e 为 e taling，读 [e]，不是 [ə]。

word_family.gloss: 男主角；与 heroin 对应的相关借词，并非去后缀派生
多位女主角；强调复数或不同人物

senses.zh_definition: 故事、小说、电影或戏剧中的主要女性角色；也可依语境指饰演该角色的女演员。
senses.en_definition: The principal female character in a story, film, or play; by extension, the actress playing that role.
senses.ms_definition: Watak wanita utama dalam cerita, filem dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 本条采用输入指定的“女主角”义，英语对应 heroine。马来语另有同形词 heroin 表示海洛因，因此翻译时必须结合剧情或演出语境；指演员时，pelakon wanita utama 更明确。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=heroin)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 介绍剧情时用 heroin，介绍演员职业或奖项时优先用 pelakon wanita utama；本义译成英语时拼作 heroine。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于讨论作品和选角时语气中性。把现实中的女性称作 heroin 可带赞赏或玩笑意味，需要双方熟悉且语境清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 介绍剧情时用 heroin，介绍演员职业或奖项时优先用 pelakon wanita utama；本义译成英语时拼作 heroine。

etymology.historical_story: 此义与英语 heroine 所代表的“女性英雄、女主人公”词汇传统相联系；英语词的更早来源可追溯至拉丁语和希腊语的女性英雄称谓。马来语词典将 heroin 的这一义项明确用于故事和电影中的主要女性人物，体现了从英雄人物到叙事主角的语义联系。[英语词源](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/heroine#Etymology_1)；[马来语释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=heroin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头想成聚光灯：hero 是男主角，灯光转向女主角时记 heroin；对应的英语拼写是 heroine。

morphology.formula: ∅ + hiburan → hiburan（按输入词根记录）；实际派生关系：hibur + -an → hiburan
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入资料的整词词根标记；语言学上，hiburan 是 hibur 加名词后缀 -an 的派生词，并非不可再分的词根。加缀时不发生辅音替换。

word_family.gloss: 表演艺人；使人开心的人或事物

senses.zh_definition: 娱乐；使人愉快、舒心或得到消遣的活动、表演或事物。
senses.en_definition: Activities, performances, or other things that provide enjoyment, amusement, or comfort.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu, seperti perbuatan atau benda, untuk menghiburkan, menyenangkan atau menenteramkan hati.
senses.nuances: 范围包括音乐、电影、演出、阅读等令人愉快的事物，不限于夜生活。hiburan 指娱乐内容或事物；berhibur 才表示进行娱乐活动。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 安排多人活动时，结合参与者的年龄、兴趣和个人习惯选择内容。hiburan 本身不表示夜店、饮酒或其他特定活动。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词语本身中性，适用于正式和日常交流。朋友之间可说 cari hiburan；在工作或家庭活动安排中，说明具体娱乐项目更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 安排多人活动时，结合参与者的年龄、兴趣和个人习惯选择内容。hiburan 本身不表示夜店、饮酒或其他特定活动。

etymology.historical_story: hiburan 的构词基础是 hibur，核心意象是让心情愉快或得到宽慰；后缀 -an 将其构成表示相关事物的名词。DBP 的词典以昔日阅读、聆听诗歌为娱乐的情景说明这个词，因此可以把传统诗歌与今天的电影、音乐联系起来理解，但不能据此断言其具体起源年代。[DBP：hibur 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=hibur)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象疲惫的人听到音乐后露出笑容：hibur 是使人开心，hibur + -an → hiburan，就是带来快乐的娱乐内容。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根，开头 h 属于词根；添加 ke-…-an 构成 kehandalan 时，词根保持不变。

word_family.gloss: 本领高强的；出类拔萃的

senses.zh_definition: 技艺高超的；在某项活动或技能上表现出色的。

etymology.historical_story: handal 在现代马来语中作为独立词根使用；DBP 所收 kehandalan 的例句以汉都亚的勇武展示其“高强本领”的意象。今天，这种称赞也适用于球员、棋手和其他能手；现有引据不足以确定它更早的借入来源或首次出现年代。参见 [DBP：handal 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=176312&keyword=handal)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一名球员稳稳接住最难的球，队友赞叹：Dia memang handal! 把 handal 与“关键时刻显真本领”连在一起。

morphology.pattern_note: 德语姓氏作为完整专名使用，不按马来语词缀拆分。规范正文写作 Hitler；音标表示一种马来语适应读法，并非德语原音。

senses.zh_definition: 希特勒：德语姓氏，在历史语境中通常指阿道夫·希特勒（1889—1945），纳粹党领袖及1933至1945年间的德国独裁者。
senses.en_definition: A German surname, usually referring in historical contexts to Adolf Hitler (1889–1945), Nazi Party leader and dictator of Germany from 1933 to 1945.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Jerman yang dalam konteks sejarah lazimnya merujuk kepada Adolf Hitler (1889–1945), pemimpin Parti Nazi dan diktator Jerman dari tahun 1933 hingga 1945.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，必须大写为 Hitler。姓氏本身并不等于“独裁者”；用于辱骂或夸张类比属于语用延伸。此处为人物识别释义，并非 DBP 官方词条引文。史实参见 [美国大屠杀纪念馆：Adolf Hitler](https://encyclopedia.ushmm.org/content/en/series/adolf-hitler?parent=en%2F11341)。

etymology.historical_story: Hitler is a German surname, not a Malay descriptive word. Its familiar historical reference is Adolf Hitler, whose Nazi dictatorship ruled Germany from 1933 to 1945 and was responsible for the Holocaust and other crimes. Malay uses the surname as an intact proper name; it should not be given an invented Malay root or affix. See the [United States Holocaust Memorial Museum](https://encyclopedia.ushmm.org/content/en/series/adolf-hitler?parent=en%2F11341).

etymology.historical_story: Hades comes from an ancient Greek divine name. Greek stories made him ruler of the underworld, and the same name also came to designate that realm. This double reference survives in modern discussions: a passage mentioning Hades may concern either a divine character or the destination of the dead. [Mythological background](https://pressbooks.bccampus.ca/greekromanmyth/chapter/the-underworld/).

etymology.historical_story: The biological name Hydra recalls the many-headed monster of Greek mythology. In the legend, severed heads returned; in the freshwater animal, damaged tissues can regenerate. This resemblance gave scientists a memorable bridge between an ancient story and a living organism, although the real animal has tentacles rather than numerous heads. [University of Geneva](https://www.unige.ch/medias/en/2025/lhydre-deux-tetes-nest-pas-quun-mythe).

senses.zh_definition: 伏低身体或隐蔽身形，以便不被发现地窥探、捕捉或袭击；通常以 menghendap 等形式使用。
senses.en_definition: To crouch or conceal oneself to watch, catch, or attack without being seen; usually used as menghendap.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bentuk menghendap: merendahkan diri atau menyembunyikan diri supaya tidak kelihatan, dengan maksud hendak mengintai, menangkap dan sebagainya.

etymology.historical_story: hendap 的更早词源尚未确定；词典记录的核心画面是一个人弯下身子，藏在遮蔽物后，不让别人看见。这个隐蔽行动的意义也体现在 serangan hendap 中，指从藏身处发动的伏击。参见 [Kamus Dewan／PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hendap)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hendap 想成草丛后压低的身影：先藏好自己，再观察或行动；加 meng-，便成为动作词 menghendap。

etymology.historical_story: English heart descends from Old English heorte. Its bodily meaning developed alongside associations with feeling, courage, and inward character. Malay divides these meanings among several expressions: jantung commonly names the pumping organ, while hati often carries emotional meanings. This contrast makes the word useful for learning why translations depend on context. [Collins: heart](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/heart)

etymology.historical_story: Hollywood's famous hillside sign began as Hollywoodland in 1923, advertising a housing development rather than a film studio. The landmark later became an emblem of the surrounding entertainment world. That history offers a memorable bridge between the word's geographical meaning and its broader use for American commercial cinema. [Hollywood Sign Trust](https://www.hollywoodsign.org/history/a-sign-is-born)

etymology.historical_story: A family-name dictionary records Hoo as a romanized Chinese surname with more than one possible source, including forms associated with Hu and He. It also notes its presence in Malaysia and Singapore. The spelling therefore preserves a family naming tradition, but cannot by itself reveal a particular bearer's Chinese characters or pronunciation. morphology.pattern_note: 单音节借词，整词记忆；不含马来语词缀，也不因修饰复数名词而添加英语 -s。

senses.zh_definition: 热门的；广受欢迎的，尤用于歌曲、电影等娱乐作品。

senses.ms_definition: Disukai ramai atau popular, khususnya tentang lagu, filem dan karya hiburan.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合朋友间谈音乐或娱乐作品。与不熟悉的人交流时，可保留 hit，但把 aku 等亲密人称换成 saya。

etymology.historical_story: hit 借自英语，用于马来语时保留了娱乐作品广受欢迎的含义。可以把这种意义想成一首歌“击中”大众的喜好，但这只是记忆联想；实际使用时，lagu hit 就是热门歌曲。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象歌曲一下“击中”大家的耳朵，人人都会哼：lagu hit，热门歌曲。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根拼写不变，-nya 读作 /ɲa/，与前面的 t 分属不同音节。此处 -nya 是后附成分；hakikatnya 用作话语标记时表示“事实上”，不宜逐字译为“他的事实”。

word_family.gloss: 确认为真实；认定为事实

senses.zh_definition: 事实上；实际上；用于引出真实情况，常与先前的印象、说法或预期形成转折。
senses.en_definition: In fact; in reality; used to introduce the actual situation, often in contrast to an appearance or assumption.
senses.ms_definition: Sebenarnya; sesungguhnya; digunakan untuk menyatakan keadaan yang benar, khususnya apabila berbeza daripada tanggapan atau jangkaan.
senses.nuances: 常见于 pada hakikatnya，也可独立置于句首。此义中的词性按其副词性话语功能标注；词根 hakikat 本身是名词。语气通常比 sebenarnya 更郑重，常用于澄清事实或揭示表象背后的情况。[DBP 用法依据](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=hakikatnya)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pada hakikatnya, kelewatan projek ini berpunca daripada kekurangan tenaga kerja, bukannya masalah pembiayaan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 事实上，这个项目的延误源于人手不足，而非资金问题。
dual_scenarios.en: In fact, the project delay stems from a shortage of workers rather than funding problems.

dual_scenarios.en: It looks easy, but there are actually lots of things to check.

nak kena + 动词在口语中表示“需要做……”，标准表达可用 perlu。
benda 在此泛指事项，标准表达可换为 perkara。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于纠正他人时，容易带出“实际情况并非如此”的强调语气。与上司、长辈或客户交谈，可先承接对方观点，再说明事实，避免显得武断。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式报告中宜用 pada hakikatnya，并紧接明确事实或依据。朋友聊天中可以使用 hakikatnya；若只是轻松补充说明，sebenarnya 往往更自然。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 用于纠正他人时，容易带出“实际情况并非如此”的强调语气。与上司、长辈或客户交谈，可先承接对方观点，再说明事实，避免显得武断。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式报告中宜用 pada hakikatnya，并紧接明确事实或依据。朋友聊天中可以使用 hakikatnya；若只是轻松补充说明，sebenarnya 往往更自然。

etymology.historical_story: hakikat 的源头是阿拉伯语 ḥaqīqah，意为“真相、真实或实质”，进入马来语后保留了“不可否认的真实情况”这一意义。马来语将它与 -nya 结合，在 pada hakikatnya 中用来引出实际情况，也形成了独立使用的 hakikatnya。[DBP 词源与释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=hakikat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hakikat 想成舞台幕后的真实场景：拉开写着 hakikatnya 的幕布，就从“看起来怎样”进入“实际上怎样”。

metadata.notes: 未取得 DBP 或权威词典公开释义

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语整词，不作马来语词缀拆分。英语读一个音节，词尾 e 不单独发音；以下词族也属于英语。

word_family.gloss: 英式英语：朴实舒适、像家一样的

senses.zh_definition: 家；个人或家庭居住并具有归属感的地方。
senses.en_definition: The place where a person lives and feels they belong.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat seseorang tinggal dan menjalani kehidupan bersama keluarga atau isi rumahnya.
senses.nuances: 本项解释英语 home，不表示它已成为马来西亚标准马来语词。标准对应词按语境为 rumah、tempat tinggal 或 kediaman；以下搭配采用马来语对应表达。[DBP：home 的对应词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kediaman)。

senses.zh_definition: 在家；回家；到家，具体意义由所搭配的动词决定。
senses.en_definition: At, to, or back to the place where one lives.
senses.ms_definition: Di rumah atau menuju dan kembali ke rumah, bergantung pada kata kerja yang digunakan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语中的副词用法。go home 对应 pulang 或 balik ke rumah；stay home 对应 berada di rumah。[Collins：home](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/home)。

senses.zh_definition: 首页；主画面，常见于英语界面中的导航标签。
senses.en_definition: An interface label for the main page or starting screen.
senses.ms_definition: Label antara muka yang merujuk kepada laman utama atau skrin utama sesuatu laman web atau aplikasi.
senses.nuances: 英语界面通常显示 Home；在马来语说明中可原样引用实际标签。若界面已经本地化，应使用 laman utama 或 skrin utama。下列搭配中的 home 表示被引用的界面标签。[马来西亚国防部系统使用手册](https://www.mod.gov.my/images/mindef/upload/manual/Panduan%20pengguna%20-%20DDMS2.pdf)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 朋友间可以随双方习惯切换英语；正式马来文中，住所通常写 rumah 或 kediaman，网页首页写 laman utama。缺少上下文时，不把 home 自动译成实体房屋。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讲解操作时引用对方屏幕上的实际标签最清楚；面对不熟悉英语的人，可说“butang home, iaitu butang laman utama”。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 朋友间可以随双方习惯切换英语；正式马来文中，住所通常写 rumah 或 kediaman，网页首页写 laman utama。缺少上下文时，不把 home 自动译成实体房屋。

etymology.historical_story: Home is inherited English vocabulary with Germanic ancestry, recorded since the Old English period. Its long history connects dwelling with belonging. Computing later extended that familiar idea to a starting location: the place users return to when navigating a system. This extension makes the interface label easy to remember. [Oxford English Dictionary: home](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/9487569112).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: home 把“家”和“首页”连起来：人回家，操作回主画面。/həʊm/ 一个音节，末尾 e 不另读。

morphology.pattern_note: 词基 hari 不变，-nya 读 /ɲa/，此处通常回指已知的日子。严格说，-nya 是附着成分；所给 هاري 是词基拼写，完整 harinya 写作 هاريڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 所说的那一天或某事发生的日子；具体所指由前文或时间短语确定。
senses.en_definition: The day associated with a previously mentioned event or time.
senses.ms_definition: Hari yang dimaksudkan atau yang berkaitan dengan peristiwa atau waktu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 在此通常起回指或确定作用，不宜机械译成“他的”。Keesokan harinya 表示“次日”，pada harinya 表示“到当天”；每天通常说 setiap hari，而不是单独说 harinya。

collocations.zh: 到当天；在所说的那一天

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 本词语气中性，适合正式叙述和日常交流；礼貌程度主要取决于整句的人称和语气。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 先交代日期或事件，再用 harinya 回指，避免听者不清楚是哪一天。日常约时间时，直接给出日期通常更明确。

etymology.historical_story: Hari 是南岛语系传承词，其历史可追溯至表示“日子、太阳”的重建形式 *waRi。这个表示日常时间单位的词与回指成分 -nya 结合，便能把叙述拉回前面提到的某一天，形成 keesokan harinya 等常用表达。词源依据：[Traces of Contact in the Lexicon](https://brill.com/display/book/9789004529458/9789004529458_webready_content_text.pdf)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hari 想成日历上的一个格子，-nya 像一根指回前文的箭头：不是随便一天，而是“说到的那一天”。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为独立词素记忆，不能拆成 has- 和 -rat；两个音节之间保留 /s.r/。派生 berhasrat 保留 h，menghasratkan 中 meN- 在 h 前实现为 meng-。

senses.zh_definition: 想要获得某物、做某事或实现某个目标的强烈愿望。

senses.ms_definition: Keinginan yang kuat untuk memiliki atau melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 比随口说的 nak 更郑重，常用于表达志向、个人心愿或机构意向；有 hasrat 并不表示已经作出承诺或落实行动。释义参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=hasrat)。

etymology.historical_story: Halnya illustrates how Malay builds reference into a word rather than always adding a separate pronoun. The noun hal supplies the idea of a matter or situation, while -nya connects it to someone or something already understood. Familiar expressions such as begitulah halnya therefore package an entire preceding discussion into a compact statement about how things stand.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hal 记成一个“事情框”，-nya 把它指向前文的人或事：halnya＝所说的那个情况。

etymology.historical_story: The English word traces back through Latin to Greek Hektōr, the name of Troy's celebrated defender. Its later bullying sense is thought to have been influenced by seventeenth-century London street gangs calling themselves Hectors. Their swaggering behaviour helped turn a heroic name into a verb for intimidating others. This history concerns English, not an established Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hector)

etymology.historical_story: 马来语词典中的 haluan 同时保留了“船头”和“方向、目标”等意义。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=haluan) 从船头所朝的位置联想到行进方向，再联想到人生或组织的发展路线，可以理解这些义项之间的联系；这是一种语义解释。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船头指向远处的灯塔：船有航向，人生也有 haluan。

senses.zh_definition: 真实存在、无法否认的事实或现实。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合报告、论说和认真交谈。用于反驳时应给出依据，避免仅凭个人判断就把某个观点称为 hakikat。

etymology.historical_story: hakikat 源自阿拉伯语 ḥaqīqah，含“真实、真理、本质”之意，进入马来语后用于讨论事物的真实情况。现代日常表达中的 menerima hakikat，把这种抽象的“真实”转成了人们必须面对和接受的现实。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象掀开一块遮布，下面的东西终于显露出来：hakikat 就是遮布下面真实存在的事实。

etymology.historical_story: English hunter combines hunt with the agent suffix -er. Its medieval history belongs to English rather than Malay word formation. The same spelling also occurs as a personal name. Consequently, an occurrence in a Malay text needs contextual interpretation before it can be translated as pemburu or retained as Hunter. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/hunter), [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/hunter_2)

etymology.historical_story: English hall comes from Old English heall, which referred to a substantial covered building or residence. Its public-room meaning survives in expressions such as town hall. The passageway meaning developed later as domestic layouts changed. These overlapping histories explain why Malay translations range from dewan to ruang masuk, koridor, and kolej kediaman. [Etymology of hall](https://www.etymonline.com/word/hall).

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合谈心愿、来意和认真考虑的计划。solat hajat 是特定的伊斯兰宗教表达，使用时应尊重对方信仰，不把普通愿望一律解释为宗教许愿。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Saya ada hajat hendak… 可用来郑重、委婉地引出来意；提出请求时，配合 jika tidak keberatan 等表达更体贴。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合谈心愿、来意和认真考虑的计划。solat hajat 是特定的伊斯兰宗教表达，使用时应尊重对方信仰，不把普通愿望一律解释为宗教许愿。

etymology.historical_story: hajat 借自阿拉伯语 حاجة（ḥāja），原义围绕‘需要、所求之事’，参见[词源记录](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/hajat#Malay)。进入马来语后，这个‘心有所求’的概念既用于日常意愿，也用于祈求心愿实现的表达；[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=hajat)保留了这些相互联系的用法。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一张写着愿望的小纸条放在心口：hajat 就是心里那件想实现、想说出口的事。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着在词后的强调语助词，并非普通派生后缀；此处按后接位置标记为 suffix。词根末尾的 k 在所列读音中读作喉塞音 /ʔ/，加上 -lah 后仍保留。

senses.zh_definition: 须；应当；务必。用于指示、规定或劝告，表示某项行为应当或必须实行。
senses.en_definition: Must or should, used to state a requirement, give an instruction, or express firm advice.
senses.ms_definition: Kata tugas yang menyatakan bahawa sesuatu mesti, harus, patut atau wajib dilakukan.
senses.nuances: 作为表示义务或要求的功能词使用；此处以 particle 对应其 kata tugas 功能，不能把整个词理解为句末语气词。通常置于谓语前，具体强度由语境决定：规章中常译为“须、必须”，劝告中可译为“应当”。它不等于表示个人意愿的 hendak，也不等于口语 nak。-lah 在这里加强要求，不使句子天然变得粗鲁。依据：[DBP PRPM：hendaklah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hendaklah)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 常见于通知、工作指示和规章，本身不表示无礼。朋友之间直接用 hendaklah 发出要求，会显得郑重、像在宣读规定；语气与双方关系决定实际感受。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 发布明确要求时可用 hendaklah；向同事或长辈提出个人请求时，可根据关系改用 boleh、tolong 或 sila。转述告示时保留 hendaklah 很自然，但不能将它缩成 nak，否则会把义务误变成意愿。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 常见于通知、工作指示和规章，本身不表示无礼。朋友之间直接用 hendaklah 发出要求，会显得郑重、像在宣读规定；语气与双方关系决定实际感受。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 发布明确要求时可用 hendaklah；向同事或长辈提出个人请求时，可根据关系改用 boleh、tolong 或 sila。转述告示时保留 hendaklah 很自然，但不能将它缩成 nak，否则会把义务误变成意愿。

etymology.historical_story: hendaklah 由表示意愿的 hendak 与强调语助词 -lah 结合而成。可以把它的意义联系理解为从“希望如此”转向“应当如此”：马来语格言中的劝诫和现代通知中的要求，都能见到这一形式；[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hendaklah)收录了相关格言及正式用例。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hendak 想成心中的“想要”，再给它盖上 -lah 的强调印章；看到 hendaklah，就联想到告示上的“须、应当”，并根据语境判断要求的强度。

morphology.formula: ∅ + high → high（英语整词；马来语对应词依语境选择）
morphology.pattern_note: 没有马来语词缀。英语读音为单音节 /haɪ/，gh 不发音；tinggi 是常见翻译对应词，不是 high 的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：高的；位置、数值、程度或等级较高的。
senses.en_definition: Situated far above a reference point, or great in amount, degree, or level.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud tinggi dari segi kedudukan, ukuran, jumlah, darjah atau taraf.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项说明，不能直接认定为规范马来语义项。标准马来语通常按语境使用 tinggi、besar、kuat 等对应词。以下搭配中的 high 为保留的英语成分，并非宣称整组是规范马来语搭配。[英语释义](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/high)

senses.zh_definition: 英语口语：极其兴奋、欣喜或情绪高涨的。

senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris tidak formal, berasa sangat gembira, teruja atau penuh semangat.

etymology.historical_story: English high descends through Middle English from Old English hēah. Its modern meanings cover physical height, elevated amounts, and emotional or intoxicated states. These senses provide a useful learning image: something rises above its ordinary level. That image is a mnemonic, not evidence that the English word has become an officially established Malay headword. [Source](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/high)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: high 读 /haɪ/，想象手往高处一抬：高度高、数值高，情绪也可能高涨；具体含义看上下文。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语单音节词，音标为英语读音；不是已经核实的马来语词根。下列词族属于英语，不属于马来语派生系统。

senses.zh_definition: 猎捕动物；动物追捕猎物。
senses.en_definition: To pursue animals for food or sport, or to pursue prey.
senses.ms_definition: Berburu atau memburu haiwan; bagi haiwan pemangsa, mengejar mangsa untuk ditangkap.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项。规范马来语按句法使用 berburu、memburu 或 memburu mangsa。DBP 将 hunt 收于英语词典栏目，不能据此认定它是正式马来语词。参见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=memburu)。搭配栏以马来语对应表达为主，并在英文栏保留目标词。

senses.zh_definition: 追踪、追捕某人，目的在于将其找到或抓获。
senses.en_definition: To track or pursue someone in order to find or capture them.
senses.ms_definition: Memburu atau menjejaki seseorang untuk mencari dan menangkapnya.
senses.nuances: 追捕人时通常对应 memburu 或 menjejaki；不宜机械译为表示打猎活动的 berburu。英语 hunt down 强调持续追寻直至找到。参见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=memburu)。

collocations.zh: 追捕罪犯直至将其抓获

senses.zh_definition: 努力寻找某物、某人或某种机会。
senses.en_definition: To search actively or persistently for something or someone.
senses.ms_definition: Mencari sesuatu atau seseorang dengan bersungguh-sungguh.
senses.nuances: 英语通常用 hunt for 加寻找对象。规范马来语一般用 mencari；商业宣传和非正式交流中出现的英语形式不因此成为正式马来语。参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hunt)。

senses.zh_definition: 一次狩猎、追捕或搜寻活动。
senses.en_definition: An activity or instance of hunting, pursuit, or searching.
senses.ms_definition: Kegiatan atau usaha berburu, memburu, atau mencari sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是英语名词用法；马来语对应词随对象而变，可用 perburuan、pemburuan 或 pencarian。treasure hunt 常指寻宝游戏。参见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=rubah)。

etymology.historical_story: English hunt descends through Middle English from Old English huntian. Its animal-pursuit meaning is recorded before the twelfth century, while the noun is recorded from the fifteenth century. Modern English also uses the word for searching, which explains expressions such as job hunting without implying literal pursuit of animals. [Source](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hunt)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hunt 想成锁定目标、一路追寻：猎物是 memburu，工作或房子通常是 mencari。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词，作为完整词根记忆，不拆分为马来语词缀。常用表达多采用短语，因此不为补足数量而列出罕见派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 业余爱好；在空闲时间经常从事、以个人兴趣和乐趣为主而非作为主要职业的活动。

senses.ms_definition: Kegemaran yang diamalkan pada waktu lapang dan bukan pekerjaan yang utama.
senses.nuances: 强调实际从事的业余活动；minat 的范围更广，也可仅表示对某事的兴趣。爱好可以偶尔带来收入，不因此自动成为主要职业。马来西亚标准用法通常说 hobi saya 或 mempunyai hobi，不把 hobi 普遍当作表示“喜欢”的动词。[DBP：hobi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=hobi)

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies hobi as an English borrowing, corresponding to hobby. Its Malay spelling represents the word as two straightforward syllables. The dictionary illustrates it with familiar leisure activities such as reading and collecting stamps. These examples capture its central cultural distinction: something enjoyed in spare time rather than pursued as one's principal occupation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hobi 和英语 hobby 连起来记：工作之外，自己喜欢反复做的事，就是 hobi。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -i 接在 hormat 后，词尾 /t/ 成为末音节 ti 的声母；音节为补全值。hormati 常见于祈使句及第一、第二人称被动结构；普通主动陈述用 menghormati。headword.jawi 依要求保留输入值 حرمت，但该写法实际对应 hormat；hormati 应写作 حرمتي。

senses.zh_definition: 以礼貌、敬意或郑重的态度对待某人；尊敬、敬重。
senses.en_definition: To treat someone with respect, courtesy or esteem.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan penghargaan kepada seseorang melalui sikap sopan dan layanan yang memuliakannya.
senses.nuances: 常见于 Hormati ibu bapa。hormati 是动词形式，不表示名词性的“敬意”。普通主动陈述应说 Kita menghormati guru；Beliau saya hormati 则是合乎标准的被动结构。DBP 的 disegani 说明受敬重的状态，无须另立为 hormati 的形容词义。[DBP：menghormati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menghormati)

senses.zh_definition: 尊重他人的权利、意见或意愿；郑重对待并遵守有关规则、协议或决定。
senses.en_definition: To respect another person's rights, views or wishes, or to honour a rule, agreement or decision.
senses.ms_definition: Mengiktiraf hak, pandangan atau kehendak pihak lain serta mematuhi ketetapan atau persetujuan yang berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 尊重意见不必然表示赞同意见；搭配协议时可译为“信守”，搭配权利时可译为“尊重”。其核心是承认对方或约定应获得适当对待。[DBP：menghormati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=menghormati)

etymology.historical_story: Hormati combines the borrowed base hormat with the Malay suffix -i. Hormat comes from Arabic ḥurma, associated with honour and dignity. The resulting Malay verb makes respect an action directed towards someone or something. Its everyday range includes parents and teachers, while public language extends the same idea to rights, wishes and agreements. [Etymology of hormat](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/hormat); [DBP meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=menghormati)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 hormat＝敬意，再把 -i 想成指向对象的箭头：hormati seseorang，把敬意落实到对方身上。

etymology.historical_story: Hogwarts is a fictional institution in J. K. Rowling’s Harry Potter world. Its castle stands in the Scottish Highlands within the story, with classrooms, towers and magical passageways. Malay speakers retain the original name when discussing the books and adaptations. Recognising that literary reference is more useful than translating the name’s apparent English components. [Source: official encyclopedia](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/locations/hogwarts).

word_family.gloss: 惊讶；困惑；处于惊讶状态

senses.zh_definition: 因所见、所闻出乎意料或难以理解而感到惊讶、诧异或惊叹的。
senses.en_definition: Surprised, puzzled, or amazed by something unexpected or unusual.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa pelik atau ganjil ketika melihat atau mendengar sesuatu; takjub, kagum.
senses.nuances: 侧重经历者的感受，既可表示欣赏性的惊叹，也可表示不解，未必含有赞美。hairan melihat 表示“看到……而惊讶”；hairan mengapa 表示“不解为什么……”。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=hairan)

senses.zh_definition: 奇怪的、异常的或令人惊异的。
senses.en_definition: Strange, extraordinary, or puzzling.
senses.ms_definition: Aneh, ajaib, pelik, ganjil.
senses.nuances: 此义描述引起惊讶的事物或情况，常见于 Hairan sungguh 等感叹结构。现代日常表达中，描述“令人惊讶的结果”通常用 keputusan yang menghairankan 更自然。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=hairan)

etymology.historical_story: Hairan was borrowed from Arabic ḥayrān, meaning bewildered, confused, or perplexed. Malay uses the borrowed word for both a person's surprised reaction and something strange or extraordinary. Its ending belongs to the borrowed word itself. Malay subsequently built its own derivatives around the full base, including menghairankan and kehairanan, showing how a loanword becomes productive locally. [Etymological reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/hairan#Malay) [Malay derivatives](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=hairan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hai 联想成惊讶的一声“嗨？”，再想到“怎么会这样？”：hairan 就是惊讶、纳闷；这是记忆联想，不是词根拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词处理，不按马来语词根或词缀拆分。所列为英语英式非卷舌读音；弱读随语流变化，后接元音时可能出现连接音 /r/。

senses.zh_definition: 她；英语第三人称单数阴性代词的宾格，用作动词或介词的宾语，也可指已知的雌性动物。
senses.en_definition: The object form of she, referring to a female person or animal.
senses.ms_definition: Kata ganti nama bahasa Inggeris yang menjadi objek kata kerja atau kata sendi dan merujuk kepada orang perempuan atau haiwan betina; padanannya bergantung pada konteks, seperti dia, beliau atau -nya.
senses.nuances: 这是英语用法，不能据此认定 her 是马来语代词。马来语 dia、beliau 和 -nya 本身不标示性别。英语中也有将船只或国家人格化的传统用法。[词性、读音与用法来源](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/her)

senses.zh_definition: 她的；英语物主限定词，放在名词或名词短语前，表示与某位女性或雌性动物的所属或关联关系。
senses.en_definition: A possessive determiner indicating association with a female person or animal.
senses.ms_definition: Penentu milik bahasa Inggeris yang hadir sebelum kata nama dan menunjukkan hubungan dengan orang perempuan atau haiwan betina; lazimnya diterjemahkan dengan -nya, dia atau beliau mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: her book 中的 her 必须带名词；独立表示“她的”通常用 hers。马来语 buku dia 也可表示“他的书”，性别须由上下文确定。[用法来源](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/her)

etymology.historical_story: English her continues older forms recorded as Old English hire or hiere. These belonged to a pronoun system that marked grammatical case. Modern English retains her in two everyday roles: an object pronoun and a possessive determiner. Malay translations instead select forms such as dia, beliau or -nya according to syntax and respect. [Historical source](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/her)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两框：help her = 帮助她；her book = 她的书。单独表示“她的”则用 hers。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语语境中作为完整外来人名处理，不拆为 her 加 shel。历史上的意第绪语昵称构词不等于马来语词缀构词。

senses.zh_definition: Hershel：传统上用作男性名字的专有名词，源于意第绪语人名，也见于美国英语姓名。
senses.en_definition: A traditionally masculine given name of Yiddish origin, also used in American English.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang secara tradisional digunakan sebagai nama lelaki, berasal daripada bahasa Yiddish dan turut digunakan dalam masyarakat berbahasa Inggeris di Amerika.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 指专有名词。名字通常首字母大写；缺少语境，无法确认具体人物。词源与“鹿”有关，但实际称呼人物时应保留其姓名，不译成动物名称。[姓名来源](https://www.behindthename.com/name/hershel)

etymology.historical_story: Hershel developed as a Yiddish diminutive of Hirsh or Hersh, a name associated with the word for deer. Jewish naming traditions preserve this connection, and related spellings include Herschel and Hirshel. When the name appears in Malay discourse, it identifies a person; its historical animal meaning does not become an ordinary Malay noun. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/hershel) [Naming tradition](https://reformjudaism.org/baby-names/hersh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Hershel 首字母大写，先认作人名；“小鹿”只帮助记词源，不代替本人姓名。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式书写采用 hari jadi。为他人安排公开庆生前宜了解其个人意愿；王室或州元首庆典应采用该活动的正式名称。

etymology.historical_story: The standard expression combines hari, meaning day, with jadi, associated with becoming or coming into existence. Together they designate a birthday. Its meaning forms a familiar unit, but standard Malay still writes the components separately. The supplied joined spelling illustrates how a familiar expression can be compressed in writing without becoming an accepted single-word headword.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hari 是“日子”，jadi 联想“来到世上”：hari jadi → 生日；书写时保留空格。

etymology.historical_story: A note in Mider ing Rat identifies haku as Malay aku, offering a documented connection rather than a verified history of the initial h. Aku belongs to an ancient Austronesian pronoun family reconstructed as *aku. This background supports comparison with aku, but does not establish when or where haku developed, or whether its spelling represents a particular pronunciation. [Literary source](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7e/Mider_ing_Rat.pdf); [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/24792).

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中的完整词根，不拆分。meN- + hina → menghina：前缀采用 meng-，保留词首 h。所列 IPA 对应末尾 a 弱化的读法；标准逐字读音也可为 /hi.na/。

senses.zh_definition: 被视为身份、地位或尊严低下的；卑微的；受鄙视的。
senses.en_definition: Lowly in status or regarded as unworthy of respect.
senses.ms_definition: Dianggap rendah dari segi taraf, kedudukan atau martabat.
senses.nuances: 描述社会评价，往往包含轻视意味，不表示贫穷者客观上低人一等。不可把它当作 miskin 的中性同义词。旧式自谦表达也可能使用 hina，但现代交往中通常不必如此贬低自己。义项依据：[DBP：hina](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=hina)。

senses.zh_definition: 行为、品性或意图卑劣可鄙、应受谴责的。
senses.en_definition: Morally base, shameful, or contemptible.
senses.ms_definition: Keji atau tercela dari segi perbuatan, kelakuan atau niat.
senses.nuances: 带有明显的道德谴责，比一般的 buruk 或 tidak baik 强烈。形容词 hina 与动词 menghina 必须区分：perbuatan hina 是“卑劣的行为”，menghina orang 是“侮辱别人”。

etymology.historical_story: Hina is borrowed from Sanskrit hīna, which includes meanings such as inferior, deficient, or low. Malay retains a distinction between low social standing and contemptible conduct. That distinction makes the word culturally revealing: describing someone's position and judging someone's behaviour can share the same adjective, although modern respectful speech should keep human dignity separate from social rank. Sources: [Etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/hina#Malay), [DBP senses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=hina).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个画面：dipandang hina＝被人看低；perbuatan hina＝行为卑劣。再加上 meng-，menghina 就是主动贬低、侮辱别人。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 按输入包保留直接基础 hargai；更底层词根为 harga。-nya 此处是附着于动词后的代词附着语，并非派生后缀；suffix 表示其后接位置。ny 表示 /ɲ/，a 与 i 分属音节。本形式可用于祈使句；日常主动陈述常省略 meN-，正式主动陈述通常用 menghargainya。official 表示可按规范构词和句法分析，不声称 DBP 单独收录此完整形式。

senses.zh_definition: 珍惜、重视或感激它、这件事或这个人；具体对象由上下文确定。

senses.ms_definition: Menentukan atau menaksir harga sesuatu yang telah disebut.

etymology.historical_story: The deeper root harga belongs to Malay’s Sanskrit-derived vocabulary and is associated with Sanskrit argha, meaning price or value. Malay morphology builds hargai from harga and adds the object clitic -nya here. The connection between monetary value and personal appreciation offers a useful semantic bridge: recognizing what something is worth can also mean recognizing someone’s contribution. etymology.historical_story: Historical comparison places haus within the Malayic inheritance: Adelaar reconstructs Proto-Malayic *haus with meanings covering thirst and physical wear. Related forms occur across several Malayic varieties. Modern Malay also uses bodily thirst as a metaphor for longing, as in haus akan ilmu. The reconstruction does not establish how the thirst and wear meanings became associated. [Adelaar, Proto-Malayic](https://fileserver-az.core.ac.uk/download/pdf/160609148.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象口渴时张口呼出 ha，再急着找水：haus＝渴；看到鞋底或轮胎，则切换到“磨损”义。这是情景联想，不是词源拆解。

etymology.historical_story: Hewan and Malaysian Malay haiwan belong to a shared vocabulary associated with Arabic ḥayawān, meaning animal or living creature. Their modern forms illustrate how related national languages can preserve different spellings for a familiar concept. DBP's regional terminology tables explicitly distinguish Indonesian hewan from Malaysian haiwan, an essential distinction for cross-border editing. [Arabic vocabulary discussion](https://repository.umy.ac.id/bitstream/handle/123456789/1967/Arif%20Humaini.%20pdf.pdf?sequence=1) [DBP regional comparison](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=animal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hewan 与 haiwan 配成一对记：意思都是“动物”，印尼写 hewan，马来西亚标准写 haiwan。

etymology.historical_story: Harold has Germanic naming roots associated with an army and ruling power. Its history includes the Old English form Hereweald and the related Scandinavian name Harald. These older elements explain the name's historical construction, but modern speakers normally use Harold simply to identify someone, without suggesting that the person commands an army. [Historical name forms](https://www.behindthename.com/name/harold).

etymology.historical_story: Halloween developed as a shortened form of All Hallows' Eve, the evening before All Saints' Day. Its name preserves a Christian calendar connection, while its wider traditions bring together several cultural influences. Costumes, ghost stories, and sweets now make the occasion recognisable internationally, although people differ in whether and how they celebrate it. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Halloween); [cultural background](https://www.loc.gov/item/today-in-history/october-31/).

senses.ms_definition: Bahasa dalam cabang Indo-Arya yang dituturkan secara meluas di India utara dan yang bentuk baku bertulisnya menggunakan tulisan Devanagari.
senses.nuances: 规范写作 bahasa Hindi，语言名称 Hindi 首字母大写。Hindi 指语言，Hindu 通常涉及印度教，二者不可混用；Hindi 也不是所有印度语言的总称。本条马来语释义为编写释义，不能冒称资料包未提供的 DBP 原文。DBP 刊物中可见 bahasa Hindi 的实际用例。[来源：DBP 刊物](https://lamanweb.dbp.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Buletin-MABBIM-2023.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: The name Hindi developed from Hind, a historical name for India, with a Persian relational ending. Earlier Arabic and Persian sources used related labels broadly for Indian languages, rather than consistently for today's standard Hindi. This history explains the name's structure without making its final i a Malay suffix or implying that Hindi itself is Persian. [Source: Oxford research repository](https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid%3A2f7c9247-ced7-4eff-a090-b5b302d8820f/files/m57eaf728beec96e0ed4fda94b490dc0e).

etymology.historical_story: English him preserves an old grammatical distinction. Old English used him as a dative form, while another form, hine, served as the masculine direct object. Over time, him took over that object role too. Its appearance in Malaysian bilingual material therefore reflects English grammar, rather than a Malay derivation or a shortened Malay word. [Source: University of Arizona linguistics text](https://dingo.sbs.arizona.edu/~hharley/PDFs/WordsBook/Chapter8b.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Hoki is borrowed from English hockey, with its spelling adapted to Malay pronunciation. The English spelling becomes a transparent two-syllable Malay word rather than a combination of native affixes. Its sporting identity remains clear in expressions such as kayu hoki and hoki padang, which connect the borrowed name to the equipment and playing surface. See [Wikikamus](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/hoki).

headword.verification_note: 未核实 hallo 为规范马来语词头。马来语问候词的规范拼写为 helo；DBP 亦收录口语形式 halo。不能把 helo 或 halo 的音标、爪夷文直接移植给 hallo。

senses.en_definition: A greeting or telephone-opening expression corresponding to hello; standard Malay uses helo.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk sapaan tidak baku dalam bahasa Melayu yang digunakan untuk memulakan perbualan atau menjawab telefon; ejaan bakunya ialah helo.
senses.nuances: 严格词类为 kata seru（感叹词／招呼语）；此处因给定词类选项限制而归入 particle。hallo 也存在于其他语言，不能仅凭字形确定借入路径。以下搭配采用规范马来语 helo。[来源：DBP 的 helo 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=helo)；[DBP 关于 hello 与 helo 的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=helo)。马来语释义为编辑性说明。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式写作采用 helo。Selamat pagi 或 Selamat sejahtera 也适合相应场合；聊天中的 hallo 不宜作为规范拼写示范。

etymology.historical_story: Hallo belongs to a wider history of European calling and greeting expressions, including English hello and hollo. Their histories involve calls for attention as well as greetings. That relationship does not establish a particular borrowing route for Malay hallo. For Malaysian Malay, DBP identifies helo as the standard spelling. [Historical discussion: Oxford University Press](https://blog.oup.com/2008/10/hello/); [Malay usage: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=helo).

etymology.historical_story: Howard has several proposed historical sources rather than one uncontested literal meaning. Accounts connect it with older French and Germanic personal names and note overlap with other surname traditions. For a Malay learner, the useful distinction is that this history belongs to the foreign name: Howard is not formed through Malay affixation. etymology.historical_story: English hard continues Old English heard, which already described firmness, difficulty, and severity. Related forms survive in German hart and Dutch hard. The connection between a resistant material and a demanding experience is therefore old. In multilingual Malaysian conversation, English hard can appear through code-switching; its presence alone does not establish an official Malay borrowing.

etymology.historical_story: English harper continues Old English hearpere, a word for someone who played the harp. The same occupational designation also became a surname, recorded from the late twelfth century. This history explains why a musical description and a capitalized personal name can share their spelling. It does not establish harper as a Malay borrowing. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/harper)

senses.nuances: 此处 particle 是本条目对话语功能的归类，具体功能接近感叹语。是否亲切、敷衍或讽刺取决于上下文；不能仅凭 haha 推断对方真的大笑。

etymology.historical_story: Haha belongs to sound imitation: its repeated syllables represent successive bursts of laughter. Its presence in Malay lexicography shows that it is more than an internet abbreviation. In messaging, that representation of a human sound also helps readers interpret tone. Similar spellings across languages do not, by themselves, establish borrowing from any particular language.

etymology.historical_story: Hartanah brings together the ideas expressed by harta, property or wealth, and tanah, land. The dictionary explicitly equates it with harta tanah. This makes the word a useful cultural bridge between land as a physical place and property as an asset discussed in valuation, development, ownership, and everyday housing conversations.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 har-ta-nah，就把 harta（财产）放到 tanah（土地）上：土地上的财产，就是房地产。

morphology.pattern_note: 依输入将 halimunan 作为独立词目处理；相关形式为 halimun。不凭词尾外形直接认定现代能产的 -an 派生关系。读音按标准马来语拼读规则标示。

senses.zh_definition: 隐形的；不能被看见的，尤指故事中因特殊能力而隐去形体的。
senses.en_definition: Invisible; unable to be seen, especially through a supernatural or fictional power.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak dapat dilihat, khususnya kerana mempunyai kuasa atau sifat yang menyembunyikan diri daripada pandangan.
senses.nuances: 常见于民间故事、奇幻作品及隐身能力的描述。一般科学语境中的“肉眼看不见”通常用 tidak dapat dilihat dengan mata kasar；不能把所有 invisible 的用法都机械译为 halimunan。参见 [DBP：halimun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=halimun.) 和 [DBP：invisible 的相关释义](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=halimunan)。

senses.zh_definition: 隐形精灵；民间传说中通常不为人眼所见的神秘族类。
senses.en_definition: An unseen supernatural being of Malay folklore; an orang bunian.
senses.ms_definition: Makhluk ghaib yang dikenali sebagai orang bunian dalam kepercayaan tradisional Melayu.
senses.nuances: 名词用法尤见于 orang halimunan 等组合；这里的传说族类不宜一概译成“鬼魂”。DBP 将 orang halimunan 与 orang bunian 联系起来。参见 [DBP：halimun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=halimun.)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于传说、小说、游戏和朋友间的想象性玩笑。避免用来嘲弄他人的宗教观念，或把传说叙述直接当作已证实的事实。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论 orang halimunan 或 orang bunian 时，可用 menurut cerita rakyat（据民间传说）表明叙述背景，尊重他人的信仰与经历。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records halimun with a Sundanese sense meaning mist and also connects it with halimunan, meaning unseen. Malay folklore gives the word a memorable setting through orang halimunan and ilmu halimunan. Mist offers a useful image of concealed forms, although that image alone does not prove the historical development of every sense. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=halimun.).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ha-li-mu-nan 配上一幅画面：雾气一罩，人影不见——halimunan，隐形。这个画面是记忆联想，不是构词解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节感叹词，不作词缀拆分；没有在此列入未经核实的派生词。syllables 和 Jawi 字段保留数据包缺值；音位式读音为 /his/。

senses.zh_definition: 表示嫌恶、不喜欢或不满的感叹语，相当于“咦！”“啧！”或“真讨厌！”，具体语气取决于情境。
senses.en_definition: An exclamation expressing dislike, disgust, or displeasure.
senses.ms_definition: Kata seru untuk menyatakan rasa tidak suka, jijik atau tidak senang.
senses.nuances: 实际词类是 kata seru（感叹词）；因指定词类枚举没有 interjection，本条归入 particle。DBP 在 is 条目中将 his、isy 列为相关感叹形式。这里不是英语表示“他的”的 his。下列搭配是常见感叹句框架，不是固定成语。[DBP：is、his 与 isy](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=is)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place his beside is and isy among expressions of aversion. These tiny words preserve a conversational reaction rather than naming an object or action. No specific historical borrowing or first attestation is established here. Their cultural interest lies in delivery: a brief exclamation can convey displeasure before the following sentence explains why. [DBP：相关感叹词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=is)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看见脏东西时先呼一声短促的 his，再皱眉说“真讨厌”；这是声音联想，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Malay ham is a whole-word borrowing corresponding to English ham. The English food term developed from an older anatomical meaning associated with the knee and leg: Old English hamm named the hollow behind the knee. The Malay dictionary retains the preserved pork-leg meaning. References: [English etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/ham) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=ham).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ham /ham/ 可借近似音联想“咸”，记住盐腌火腿；这是助记联想，并非汉语词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语语境中作为日语整词处理，不按马来语词缀拆分；音标为近似读音，非已核实的马来语规范读音。

senses.zh_definition: 日语中的“烟花、焰火”；在马来语文本中可作为介绍日本文化时使用的外语词。
senses.en_definition: The Japanese word for fireworks, used as a foreign term in discussions of Japanese culture.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Jepun yang bermaksud bunga api, digunakan dalam konteks kebudayaan Jepun.
senses.nuances: 未核实为DBP收录的标准马来语普通词，因此不标为official。一般马来语用bunga api。这里解释日语普通名词义；若原文指人物、游戏或活动名称，须另按专名理解。以下搭配属于日本文化语境，不代表马来语高频搭配。[日本政府：烟花文化](https://www.japan.go.jp/tomodachi/2014/summer2014/seasons_and_customs.html)

etymology.historical_story: Japanese hanabi is written 花火, combining the images of flowers and fire. The name pictures sparks opening like petals against the night sky. Fireworks are closely associated with Japanese summer festivities. In Malay cultural discussion, the Japanese label may be retained, while bunga api remains the ordinary Malay expression. [Government of Japan](https://www.japan.go.jp/tomodachi/2014/summer2014/seasons_and_customs.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把hanabi记成夜空中的“火之花”：花瓣一开，就是烟花。

etymology.historical_story: English hell continues Old English hel or helle and belongs to a Germanic family of words for the underworld. etymology.historical_story: Hive descends from Old English hȳf and has Germanic ancestry. Its familiar association with a bee dwelling also supports the sense of the colony inside. English further uses the image of many working bees metaphorically in a hive of activity, describing a place crowded with busy people. [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/hive_1)

etymology.historical_story: The English covering word hood continues Old English hod, meaning a head covering. Its sense expanded to covers for equipment and vehicles. English also has separately developed slang uses, including a shortening of neighborhood. These histories explain English meanings; they do not establish that the submitted spelling is an official Malay headword. See [Etymonline: hood](https://www.etymonline.com/word/hood).

etymology.historical_story: Harian is transparently formed from hari, meaning day, with -an. Its uses organize life into daily units: records, wages, routines, and newspaper publication. This provides a useful cultural link between household schedules and institutional record keeping. The familiar newspaper expression akhbar harian expresses the same daily rhythm. [DBP entry for hari](https://ekamus.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?cari=hari&type=1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hari 是“一天”，hari + -an 就把事情按天安排：laporan harian，每天一份报告。

etymology.historical_story: Hudson illustrates how a personal name can become a geographical name. The Hudson River was named after Henry Hudson, who explored it in 1609 while working for the Dutch East India Company. In Malay, Sungai supplies the geographical category, while Hudson remains the identifying proper name. [Historical reference](https://www.nps.gov/places/bard-rock.htm).

etymology.historical_story: Hawaii preserves an Indigenous Hawaiian place name rather than a Malay formation. The Hawaiian spelling Hawaiʻi contains an ʻokina, a consonant representing a glottal stop. The same name identifies both a state and its largest island, so geographical context matters. Hawaiian naming authorities emphasize evidence and local knowledge when establishing spellings and diacritics. [Hawaiʻi Board on Geographic Names](https://planning.hawaii.gov/gis/hbgn/).

etymology.historical_story: Heather has a long history in Scots and northern English usage. Oxford traces it to Old English forms preserved in place names, while leaving its ultimate origin unknown. Association with heath later influenced its spelling. The plant name also became the personal name Heather; neither use establishes it as an official Malay headword. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/heather_1)

etymology.historical_story: Helena belongs to the European naming tradition associated with Greek Helen and its Latin forms. Ancient literature and the later prominence of Saint Helena helped preserve the name across languages. etymology.historical_story: Hazel began as an English tree word, continuing Old English hæsel. The colour term developed through association with the colour of hazelnuts, while Hazel also became a personal name in the nineteenth century. These histories explain why the same spelling can identify a person, a plant, or an eye colour. Malay readers must use the surrounding sentence to select the intended meaning. [Sources: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/hazel), [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/hazel).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Hazel 近似“黑兹尔”：大写想到人名，小写遇到 pokok 想到榛树，遇到 mata 想到榛色眼睛。

senses.en_definition: To smell or sniff something through the nose.
senses.ms_definition: Mencium atau membaui sesuatu dengan hidung.

senses.en_definition: To draw air, gas, smoke, or another airborne substance in through the nose.
senses.ms_definition: Menyedut udara, gas atau bahan seumpamanya melalui hidung.
senses.nuances: 重点是吸入动作，不一定是在辨别气味。日常原形 hidu 常见于口语；正式陈述一般使用 menghidu，无意吸入则常用 terhidu。

senses.zh_definition: 通过残留气味发现或追踪人、动物或物品。
senses.en_definition: To detect or track someone or something by scent.
senses.ms_definition: Mengesan atau menjejaki seseorang atau sesuatu melalui bau yang ditinggalkan.
senses.nuances: 常用于搜寻犬或其他动物追踪气味。与第一义的区别在于，这里嗅闻的目的是发现目标或追踪去向。正式叙述常用 menghidu。

senses.ms_definition: Mengetahui perkara yang dirahsiakan melalui pemerhatian, pertanyaan atau penyiasatan.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法，接近中文的“嗅出端倪”，不涉及真实气味。正式报道常用 menghidu 或被动形式 dihidu。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary record offers a small story of semantic expansion: hidu connects the physical acts of smelling and inhaling with following a scent and uncovering a secret. Its figurative use turns the nose into an investigator. This development explains the related meanings without requiring an unsupported claim about the word's earliest origin. senses.ms_definition: Benda bernyawa atau organisma yang hidup, termasuk haiwan, tumbuhan dan mikroorganisma.
senses.nuances: 可指单个生物，也可作集合概念。hidupan 强调“活着的生物”，kehidupan 通常指生活、生命状态或生活经历；hidupan liar 指野生动物时尤其常见，但具体范围须结合上下文。释义依据 [DBP：hidupan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=hidupan) 改写。

senses.nuances: 这是词典记录的较旧用法；现代农业、公文及日常交流通常用 ternakan 或 haiwan ternakan 更清楚。旧式 hidup-hidupan 的含义应结合上下文判断。参见 [DBP：hidupan 的家畜义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=hidupan)。

etymology.historical_story: Hidupan combines hidup with the Malay suffix -an. Its root belongs to an inherited Austronesian word family reconstructed as *qudip, associated with life, growth and vitality. Related forms occur across many island languages. Malay uses this old root productively: hidupan names living organisms, while kehidupan commonly describes life or the experience of living. [Comparative evidence](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/27850).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hidup 是“活着”，加上 -an，把“活着的状态”聚焦为“活着的东西”：hidupan＝生物。

etymology.historical_story: Hiasan illustrates an everyday Malay word-building pattern: hias names decorating, while -an names its result or material expression. The same family connects personal adornment with decorated rooms and objects. Remembering this relationship lets a learner move naturally from someone decorating a space to the decorations that remain afterward. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=hias)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hias 是“装饰这个动作”，加 -an 得到 hiasan：“装饰出来的东西”。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着在词后的强调语气助词，不是改变词类的派生后缀；此处按字段选项归入 suffix。词根不变，ai 为双元音。输入 Jawi 为词根拼写，未显示 -lah；输入未提供完整词形的音节划分。

senses.zh_definition: 真感到惊讶、纳闷或赞叹；对所见所闻出乎意料而产生强烈反应。
senses.en_definition: Indeed surprised, puzzled, or amazed; hairan with emphatic -lah.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa pelik, takjub atau kagum terhadap sesuatu yang dilihat atau didengar, dengan penegasan oleh partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 可以表达赞叹，也可以表达怀疑或不解。-lah 的效果取决于语调，并非一律表示不耐烦。tidak hairanlah 则表示“难怪；不足为奇”。

senses.zh_definition: 真奇怪；真不可思议。强调某件事不同寻常或难以解释。
senses.en_definition: Strange or remarkable indeed; expressing an emphatic judgment that something is unusual.
senses.ms_definition: Aneh, ganjil atau luar biasa, dengan penegasan oleh partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 常见于带主观评价的谈话。对他人的决定说 hairanlah，可能被理解为质疑其判断；正式询问原因时宜明确提出问题。

etymology.historical_story: Hairan comes from Arabic ḥayrān, associated with bewilderment or perplexity. In Malay, its meanings also cover amazement and the judgment that something is strange. Adding the Malay particle -lah turns that reaction into an emphatic utterance. The familiar expression tidak hairanlah reverses the expectation: the surprising event now becomes understandable.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hairan＝纳闷；加 lah，把心里的“怎么回事？”说出来。再记 tidak hairanlah＝难怪。

etymology.historical_story: Hans developed as a shortened form of the male given name Johannes. This history concerns a personal name, not a Malay root or affix. When Hans appears in a Malay sentence, it identifies someone rather than expressing a separate Malay lexical meaning. Its presence in a word-frequency list therefore does not establish ordinary-word status. Source: [Duden](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Hans_Mann).

senses.zh_definition: 发出持续而响亮的嚎叫；也指因疼痛、悲伤或大笑而放声叫喊。
senses.en_definition: To give a prolonged loud cry, especially like a dog or wolf, or to cry out with strong emotion.

senses.en_definition: Of wind, to make a loud, prolonged rushing sound.
senses.ms_definition: Tentang angin, bertiup dengan mengeluarkan bunyi deruan yang kuat.
senses.nuances: 描写声音，不表示风真的在哭叫；标准马来语常用 menderu。以下搭配为马来语对应表达。参见 [Cambridge 英马词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english-malaysian/howl)。

senses.en_definition: A prolonged loud cry or a similar sound made by the wind.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi lolongan, raungan atau deruan angin yang kuat dan berpanjangan.
senses.nuances: 英语可数名词，可说 a howl、several howls；马来语依声源选择 lolongan、raungan 或 deruan。以下搭配为马来语对应表达。参见 [Cambridge 英马词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english-malaysian/howl)。

senses.en_definition: A loud, vehement expression of protest or disapproval.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan dalam bahasa Inggeris, bantahan atau tentangan yang disuarakan dengan kuat.
senses.nuances: 常见英语搭配 howls of protest；标准马来语新闻通常使用 bantahan keras 等表达。以下搭配为马来语对应表达。参见 [Cambridge：howl](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english-malaysian/howl)。

etymology.historical_story: English howl continues Middle English houlen and is related to Middle High German hiulen. Its history belongs to English rather than Malay word formation. The long cry of a dog provides a useful bridge to its other meanings: people can howl in pain or laughter, while strong wind can produce a comparable sustained sound. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/howl)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 连写，ny 表示单一鼻音 /ɲ/，词根不发生音变。依本结构归入 suffix，但语法上须区分代词附着成分与强调性后附成分。资料包的 حرمت 仅对应词根 hormat，故保留原值；完整形式按拼合应为 حرمتڽ。音节和宽式音标为补充。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的敬意、尊重；指前文所述之人对某人或某事所持的敬重态度。
senses.en_definition: His or her respect or esteem for someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Rasa hormat atau penghargaan yang dimiliki atau ditunjukkan oleh orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 这是 hormat 与第三人称附着成分 -nya 的组合义，并非必须另立的独立词根。例如 rasa hormatnya kepada guru 指“他对老师的敬意”。-nya 不区分男女，所指须由语境确定。[DBP：-nya 的语法功能](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=keterangan+nya)

senses.zh_definition: 恭敬地；谨此。主要出现在 dengan hormatnya 或 dengan segala hormatnya 中，用于礼貌地引出公函中的通知、邀请或请求。
senses.en_definition: Respectfully; used in the formal expressions dengan hormatnya and dengan segala hormatnya.

etymology.historical_story: Hormat is an Arabic loan associated with hurma, a word connected with honour and dignity. Malay combines this borrowed base with its own grammatical element -nya. The resulting form can identify someone's respect, while the established expression dengan hormatnya serves a courteous function in official correspondence. Its meaning therefore depends on the construction, not merely the ending. [Arabic–Malay cognate study](https://oarep.usim.edu.my/server/api/core/bitstreams/559de856-f8c5-4f4f-93fb-3f5ea7b86ce1/content)

etymology.historical_story: Heights is the English plural of height. Its meanings extend from measurable vertical distance to elevated land and figurative achievement. In Malaysia, it can also appear inside an established place name such as Putra Heights. Retaining that name in a Malay sentence preserves the place's identity; it does not turn the English plural ending into a productive Malay suffix.

etymology.historical_story: Hukumannya illustrates how Malay builds meaning in layers. The base hukum supports hukuman, naming a punishment or judicial sentence. Adding -nya then links that noun to a person or matter already understood. The final form can therefore describe someone's school punishment or a court sentence without creating a new, unrelated dictionary meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三层记：hukum 是规则或裁决，hukuman 是处罚，hukumannya 是“他／她的处罚”或“那件事的处罚”；-nya 负责回指。

etymology.historical_story: As an English personal name, Hugh comes through medieval French from a Germanic naming element associated with mind or spirit. etymology.historical_story: Malaysian texts contain personal names from many linguistic traditions, and a name's presence does not establish a common-word meaning. Harmon is attested in a Malaysian teacher's name. Its resemblance to harmoni is insufficient evidence of a shared origin. Without contextual identification, neither a particular name history nor a missing final letter should be assumed.

etymology.historical_story: Herba ultimately connects with Latin herba, meaning grass or green vegetation. Malaysian botanical writing retains the association with soft, non-woody plants, while everyday usage also connects the word with cooking, fragrance, and traditional plant preparations. This explains why a herb garden and a herbal product can evoke related ideas without describing exactly the same botanical category. See [UiTM: Herba dan Kampus Khazanah Alam](https://ir.uitm.edu.my/59213/1/59213.PDF).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 herba 与英语 herb 连起来记：共同想到厨房里的香草和花园里的药草；词尾 a 也是 herba 整词的一部分。

etymology.historical_story: Hidangkan is transparently formed from hidang and the suffix -kan. Its familiar setting is the shared meal: food is brought out for others to enjoy. Malay dictionaries also record figurative extensions to presenting issues and performances. These connected meanings offer a cultural image of ideas and entertainment being served to an audience.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 地理描述通常中性；把别人称为 orang hulu，并带着嘲笑口吻，可能暗示对方土气或落后。介绍群体时优先使用其自称或具体地名。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 地名中的 Hulu 保留大写，如 Hulu Langat。gering hulu 等传统宫廷表达应按特定语境理解，不宜随意套用于普通人的日常对话。

etymology.historical_story: Hulu continues an inherited Austronesian word associated with the head, upper part, and source. Comparative evidence connects Malay hulu with related forms across the language family. Its meanings make a coherent spatial network: a river has an upper end, a blade has a handle, and an undertaking has a beginning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从头部流出的河：hulu 连起“头、上游、起点”；刀柄则是握持的一端。

morphology.formula: ∅ + hornet → hornet（英语整词；马来语对应词为 tebuan）

senses.zh_definition: 胡蜂、虎头蜂；英语中指具有螫针的大型社会性胡蜂，马来语通常称 tebuan。
senses.en_definition: A large social wasp with a sting; Malay equivalent: tebuan.
senses.ms_definition: Serangga penyengat daripada kumpulan tebuan; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah tebuan.
senses.nuances: 此义是英语词义，可见于马英夹杂的交流。PRPM 将 hornet 列在英马词典中，译为 tebuan；这不等于确认 hornet 已成为标准马来语普通名词。正式马来语宜用 tebuan。[PRPM：hornet](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=75076&keyword=hornet)

senses.zh_definition: “大黄蜂”；F/A-18系列战斗攻击机名称中的专名。
senses.en_definition: Hornet; the aircraft name used for the F/A-18 fighter and attack aircraft.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi pesawat tempur F/A-18 yang berkeupayaan menjalankan tugas pejuang dan serangan.
senses.nuances: 航空和国防报道中通常保留大写 Hornet，如 F/A-18D Hornet。它在这里是机型名称，不是昆虫的马来语通称；Super Hornet 则是另一相关机型名称。[马来西亚皇家空军用例](https://www.airforce.mil.my/index.php/en/information/news2/main-news2/panglima-tentera-udara-lawat-lokasi-insiden-kemalangan-pesawat-f-a-18d-hornet)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan latihan itu merangkumi penyertaan pesawat F/A-18D Hornet.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该训练报告涵盖了F/A-18D“大黄蜂”战机的参训情况。
dual_scenarios.en: The training report covers the participation of F/A-18D Hornet aircraft.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Eh, ada hornet kat luar tingkap tu!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Ada seekor tebuan di luar tingkap itu!
dual_scenarios.zh: 诶，窗外有只虎头蜂！
dual_scenarios.en: Hey, there's a hornet outside that window!
spoken_features: hornet 是英语词，体现马来西亚日常交流中的语码转换。
kat 对应标准语的 di。
tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式。
eh 用于提醒对方注意。

messages.speaker: Farah (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Eh, ada hornet kat luar tingkap tu!
messages.ms_standard: Ada seekor tebuan di luar tingkap itu!
messages.zh: 诶，窗外有只虎头蜂！
messages.en: Hey, there's a hornet outside that window!

messages.speaker: Amir (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah nampak. Tutup tingkap je dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah melihatnya. Tutup tingkap itu dahulu.
messages.zh: 我看到了。先把窗关上吧。
messages.en: I saw it. Just close the window for now.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 朋友之间夹用 hornet 很容易理解；面对不熟悉英语的听者，说 tebuan 更清楚。正式马来语昆虫说明采用 tebuan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈昆虫时用小写 hornet；谈机型时保留 Hornet 的大写及型号。不要仅因本条保留了指定的 official 状态字段，就将英语普通名词解释为已获DBP认可的马来语借词。
